item.title: Why France's under-15 social media ban was blocked
item.description: France's attempt to ban social media for under-15s has been blocked by the Constitutional Council, which ruled the measure unconstitutional. Speaking to FRANCE 24, Peter Craddock, Senior Attorney advising social media companies, said the decision was unsurprising, arguing that the proposed law imposed a blanket ban without taking into account differences between platforms or children's levels of maturity. The court found that the measure infringed on the fundamental freedom of expression and information. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: University spinout to launch water quality app for UK and US waters
item.description: Molendotech will collate data from daily tests that detect E coli and other bacteria amid reports of swimmers falling ill A UK university spinout behind a rapid bacterial water testing kit is planning to launch live water quality maps, as scores of beachgoers report falling ill after swimming. Molendotech, a spinout from the University of Plymouth, sells a portable test that detects E coli and other bacteria in water and delivers results on the spot, without waiting for days to get laboratory results. The government has announced that landlords will need to ensure their properties have energy performance certificate (EPC) ratings of C or higher by 2030 – up from the current requirement of an E. Em sua resposta à agência, o Discord também se manifestou sobre o caso do suicídio de uma adolescente de 13 anos. A plataforma classificou o ocorrido como um caso isolado, e não uma falha sistêmica, alegando que, com base nas informações disponíveis, o ato consumado não foi transmitido dentro do aplicativo. ➡️ Assista ao #JornalGloboNews na TV e no Globoplay | GloboNews
